vehicleDetails.title: 450 S
vehicleDetails.description:
The Ather 450S is a key model in Ather Energy’s lineup, designed as a practical, urban-focused electric scooter that retains the brand's signature handling and build quality. It is currently available in two battery configurations, allowing riders to choose the range that best fits their daily commuting needs.

Ather 450S Lineup Overview

Detailed Breakdown

  • Ather 450S (2.9 kWh): This is the entry-level variant, perfect for riders with predictable, daily city routes. It provides a lightweight and agile experience, making it highly maneuverable in dense traffic. It features the durable 7-inch DeepView™ LCD display, which provides essential ride data and turn-by-turn navigation via Bluetooth connectivity.
  • Ather 450S (3.7 kWh): Introduced to bridge the gap between entry-level commuters and premium performance models, this variant is designed for riders who need extended range. By utilizing a larger battery pack, it pushes the certified range to 161 km, effectively eliminating range anxiety for longer inter-city commutes without requiring a move to the more expensive 450X range.

Why Choose the Ather 450S?

The Ather 450S is best suited for riders who prioritize the core Ather experience—sharp handling, robust aluminum chassis, and proven reliability—over high-end gadgetry like large touchscreen displays or aggressive racing modes.

  • Pragmatic Design: By using the DeepView™ LCD dashboard instead of a full-color touchscreen, the 450S maintains a lower price point while still offering modern smart features like over-the-air (OTA) updates, geo-fencing, and theft alerts.
  • Consistent Performance: Regardless of the battery pack, both models deliver the same 90 km/h top speed and 5.4 kW peak power, ensuring a consistent and spirited riding experience.
  • Ownership Benefits: Both variants benefit from Ather’s extensive fast-charging network and robust safety suite, including FallSafe™ (motor cut-off during a tip-over) and Emergency Stop Signal (ESS).

variantData.description:
The Ather 450S (2.9 kWh) is the gateway to premium electric mobility. Designed as the perfect entry point into the legendary Ather ecosystem, it delivers the brand's signature razor-sharp handling, robust build quality, and spirited performance in a highly accessible package. By focusing on essential smart features and a battery perfectly sized for daily city runs, the 450S offers an uncompromised riding experience for the pragmatic, everyday commuter.

Key Performance & Specifications

  • Optimized City Range: Powered by a highly efficient 2.9 kWh Lithium-ion battery, the 450S delivers a reliable IDC (Indian Driving Cycle) range of 122 km. This translates to ample real-world mileage for standard daily commutes, office runs, and errands without unnecessary bulk.
  • Spirited Powertrain: It doesn't skimp on performance. Utilizing a 5.4 kW PMSM motor with 22 Nm of peak torque, it achieves a top speed of 90 km/h and zips from 0–40 km/h in a brisk 3.9 seconds.
  • DeepView™ LCD Console: Instead of a complex touchscreen, the 450S introduces Ather's brilliant 7-inch DeepView™ Display. It provides exceptional contrast and readability in bright sunlight, offering intuitive turn-by-turn navigation, Bluetooth connectivity, and vital ride data at a glance.
  • Core Smart Tech: It comes standard with four highly calibrated riding modes (SmartEco, Eco, Ride, and Sport) and essential safety features like FallSafe™ (motor cut-off upon tipping) and Emergency Stop Signal (ESS).

Variant Comparison: Stepping Up the Ather 450 Ladder

The Ather 450S (2.9 kWh) is the foundation of the lineup. Here is how it compares to its higher-spec siblings to help you find the perfect fit.

1. Ather 450S (2.9 kWh) VS. Ather 450S (3.7 kWh): The Range Extension

If you love the simplicity of the DeepView™ display but need to travel further, this is your comparison.

  • Shared Tech: Both models feature the exact same 5.4 kW motor, 90 km/h top speed, and the rugged 7-inch DeepView™ LCD dashboard.
  • The Endurance Gap: The Ather 450S (2.9 kWh) provides a 122 km IDC range, perfect for localized city riding. The Ather 450S (3.7 kWh) utilizes a larger battery pack to push that range up to 161 km, making it the better choice for long inter-city commutes.
  • Verdict: Choose the Ather 450S (2.9 kWh) for predictable, everyday city routes. Upgrade to the 3.7 kWh variant only if you suffer from range anxiety or have exceptionally long daily travel requirements.

2. Ather 450S (2.9 kWh) VS. Ather 450X (2.9 kWh): The Touchscreen Upgrade

This comparison is for riders who want the same battery capacity but crave a more premium, interactive cockpit.

  • Identical Range: Both scooters use the 2.9 kWh battery and offer highly similar range figures suited for city travel.
  • The "X" Factor: The Ather 450S (2.9 kWh) uses the non-touch DeepView™ LCD. The Ather 450X (2.9 kWh) upgrades the experience to a full 7-inch TFT Touchscreen, unlocking built-in Google Maps, document storage, and the ultra-aggressive Warp Mode for maximum acceleration.
  • Verdict: If you prefer tactile switches and straightforward navigation, the Ather 450S (2.9 kWh) is excellent. If you want a smartphone-like interactive dashboard and sports-car acceleration, the 450X is the necessary upgrade.

3. Ather 450S (2.9 kWh) VS. Ather 450X (3.7 kWh): The Ultimate Flagship

Comparing the entry model to the flagship highlights the full spectrum of the 450 series.

  • The Spec Gap: The Ather 450X (3.7 kWh) boasts the largest battery (161 km range), the highest power (6.4 kW peak), and the premium TFT Touchscreen.
  • The Advantage: The Ather 450S (2.9 kWh) remains the lighter, more agile, and straightforward machine. It gives you the core Ather chassis, suspension, and build quality without the premium additions you may not need for simple daily travel.
  • Verdict: The 450X (3.7 kWh) is for the enthusiast who wants everything. The Ather 450S (2.9 kWh) is the pragmatic choice for the value-conscious commuter.

Why Choose the Ather 450S (2.9 kWh)?

The Ather 450S (2.9 kWh) is the smartest choice for the pure city commuter. It strips away the luxury "extras" like touchscreens and high-drain Warp modes, focusing purely on what makes an electric scooter great: a perfectly balanced chassis, a zippy 90 km/h motor, and a reliable 122 km range. It is the authentic Ather experience, refined for everyday practicality.

variantData.title: 450 S 3.7 Kwh
variantData.description:
The Ather 450S (3.7 kWh) is engineered for the modern urban rider who demands extended range without sacrificing Ather’s signature sharp handling and smart connectivity. It bridges the gap between the entry-level commuter and the premium performance tier. By pairing the robust 450 Series hybrid aluminum chassis with a high-capacity battery, this variant ensures you spend more time on the road and less time plugged in, all while navigating city traffic with effortless agility.

Key Performance & Specifications

  • Extended Endurance : The defining upgrade for this variant is the larger 3.7 kWh Lithium-ion battery. It delivers a highly impressive certified range of 161 km, allowing for multiple days of city commuting on a single charge.
  • Optimized Powertrain : Powered by a reliable PMSM motor producing a peak output of 5.4 kW and 22 Nm of torque, it offers smooth, linear acceleration.
  • City-Ready Speed : It reaches a top speed of 90 km/h and sprints from 0–40 km/h in a brisk 3.9 seconds, making it perfectly suited for quick overtakes and flyover climbs.
  • DeepView™ Display : The cockpit features Ather's intuitive 7-inch DeepView™ LCD display. It is loaded with smart features including turn-by-turn navigation, Bluetooth call/music control, and OTA update capabilities via AtherStack.
  • Safety & Practicality : It comes standard with a 22-liter under-seat storage compartment, dual disc brakes with CBS, AutoHold™ for slopes, and FallSafe™ technology that cuts off the motor in the event of a tip-over.

Which Ather 450 is Right for You?

The Ather 450 lineup offers distinct configurations based on your need for tech, speed, and distance. Here is how the 450S (3.7 kWh) compares to its siblings.

1. Ather 450 S 3.7 Kwh VS Ather 450 S 2.9 kWh : The Range Upgrade

If you are deciding within the "S" badge, the choice comes down entirely to battery capacity.
The Ather 450S (2.9 kWh) is the entry point to the family.

  • Identical Performance: Both the 2.9 kWh and 3.7 kWh versions of the 450S share the exact same 5.4 kW motor, DeepView™ display, and 90 km/h top speed.
  • The Distance Advantage: The smaller battery yields a certified range of 122 km. The Ather 450S (3.7 kWh) pushes that significantly higher to 161 km, eliminating range anxiety for longer daily routes.
  • Verdict: For short, predictable daily trips, the 2.9 kWh model suffices. If your commute varies or you prefer charging less frequently, the 3.7 kWh upgrade is essential.

2. Ather 450 S 3.7 Kwh VS Ather 450X 3.7 kWh: Tech & Power Dynamics

The Ather 450X (3.7 kWh) is the premium sibling, offering enhancements in power and user interface.

  • Shared Battery: Both scooters utilize the identical 3.7 kWh battery pack, resulting in the same 161 km certified range.
  • Motor & Acceleration: The 450X features a more powerful 6.4 kW motor and 26 Nm of torque, unlocking the aggressive "Warp Mode." It reaches 40 km/h in just 3.3 seconds, compared to the 450S's 3.9 seconds.
  • Dashboard Tech: The 450X replaces the LCD screen with a full-color 7-inch TFT touchscreen display for a more premium, interactive experience.
  • Verdict: The 450S (3.7 kWh) is the smart choice for range-focused riders who don't need track-level acceleration or a touchscreen. Choose the 450X only if Warp Mode and premium UI are must-haves.

3. Ather 450 S 3.7 Kwh VS Ather 450 Apex: Commuter vs. Enthusiast

Comparing the 450S to the flagship Ather 450 Apex highlights the extremes of the 450 platform.

  • The Performance Gap: The Apex is built for raw thrill, featuring a 7.0 kW motor, a 100 km/h top speed, and an exclusive Warp+ mode. The 450S remains at a sensible 90 km/h.
  • Braking Tech: The Apex introduces the innovative "Magic Twist" regenerative braking system, which is absent on the standard 450S.
  • Verdict: The Apex is a collector’s item for sheer driving pleasure. The Ather 450S (3.7 kWh) remains the pragmatic, high-efficiency workhorse for everyday utility.

Why Choose the Ather 450S 3.7 kWh?

The Ather 450S (3.7 kWh) hits the ultimate sweet spot in the lineup. It gives you the exact same 161 km maximum range as the premium 450X, but pairs it with the highly efficient 5.4 kW motor and durable DeepView™ display. It is the perfect electric scooter for the rider who prioritizes maximum distance, intelligent navigation, and proven Ather reliability over touchscreen gadgets and aggressive racing modes.
